causal_hierarchy: 5. TRAJECTORY_CASCADE: earlier differing output caused later divergence
key_finding: All GOLD/INFERRED discrepancies are attributable to backend response variance or trajectory cascades, NOT to relation extraction errors. Zero RELATION_EXTRACTION_ERROR attributions across 300 tasks x 3 representations = 900 pairs. The extractor produces identical graphs, confirming the pipeline transfer is clean. 63 TRAJECTORY_CASCADE + 1 BACKEND_RESPONSE_VARIANCE = 64 total discrepancies, all caused by non-deterministic model outputs at temperature 0 (consistent with I3.11f findings).
